title: The Language of the old quarter
author: Felix Blackwood
blurb: Rosalind Quintana, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
